items.title: sound
items.description: Procedural WebAudio cues (cursor-move, select, confirm, cancel, open, close, error, typing-tick) with one shared lazy AudioContext. Off by default; muted while the window is blurred.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. All sounds are synthesized at runtime with WebAudio oscillators and noise; no audio files are shipped. Enable with <YorhaProvider sound={{ enabled: true }}>. Import with: import { useSound } from "@/lib/sound".
